request.path: payout_batch_job -> app.services.payouts.create_batch(period_key=<a payout date>), run in the worker container

note: SIMULATION of the schedule: in production the ARQ cron runs daily and makes a batch only on a payout day (Mondays when the policy says weekly). Here the same function was run for a payout date a week ahead. Three of the five caregivers get a payout: one is below the minimum, one changed bank account 12 hours ago.
